library(shiny)
library(ggplot2)

# Function to draw the mountain scene
draw_scene <- function() {
  # Set up plot area with trimmed margins
  par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0), bg = "lightblue")
  plot(NA, xlim = c(-1.8, 1.8), ylim = c(-1.5, 1.2), asp = 1, 
       xlab = "", ylab = "", axes = FALSE, bty = "n")
  
  # Draw gradient sky
  rect(-1.8, -1.5, 1.8, 1.2, col = colorRampPalette(c("skyblue", "lightblue"))(100), border = NA)
  
  # Draw realistic mountain
  mountain_x <- c(-1.5, -1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1, 1.5)
  mountain_y <- c(-1.2, -0.5, 0, 0.8, 0.2, -0.4, -1.2)
  polygon(mountain_x, mountain_y, col = "saddlebrown", border = NA)
  
  # Add snow cap only on peak
  snow_x <- c(-0.3, 0, 0.3)
  snow_y <- c(0.5, 0.8, 0.5)
  polygon(snow_x, snow_y, col = "white", border = NA)
  
  # Add rocky details
  points(c(-0.8, -0.4, 0.4, 0.7), c(-0.3, 0.2, 0.1, -0.2), 
         pch = 15, cex = c(1.2, 0.8, 1, 0.7), col = "gray30")
  
  # Draw river with controlled meandering
  river_y <- seq(0.6, -1.5, length.out = 200)
  
  # Amplitude increases as river flows down
  amplitude <- seq(0, 0.4, length.out = length(river_y))^1.5
  river_x <- amplitude * sin(10 * pi * river_y)
  
  lines(river_x, river_y, col = "dodgerblue", lwd = 2.5)
  
  # Add river banks
  bank_width <- 0.05 + 0.1 * amplitude
  lines(river_x + bank_width, river_y, col = "saddlebrown", lwd = 1)
  lines(river_x - bank_width, river_y, col = "saddlebrown", lwd = 1)
  
  # Function to draw visible snails with offset labels
  draw_snail <- function(x, y, angle, size, color, label) {
    # Draw shell (spiral)
    n_turns <- 2.5
    t <- seq(0, n_turns * 2 * pi, length.out = 100)
    spiral_r <- seq(0, size, length.out = length(t))
    shell_x <- x + spiral_r * cos(t + angle)
    shell_y <- y + spiral_r * sin(t + angle)
    polygon(shell_x, shell_y, col = color, border = "black")
    
    # Draw body
    body_x <- x + c(0, size * 0.8, size * 1.2) * cos(angle + pi)
    body_y <- y + c(0, size * 0.8, size * 1.2) * sin(angle + pi)
    lines(body_x, body_y, lwd = 1.5, col = "darkgray", type = "o", pch = 16, cex = 0.8)
    
    # Draw tentacles
    segments(body_x[3], body_y[3], 
             body_x[3] + size * 0.6 * cos(angle + pi + 0.5),
             body_y[3] + size * 0.6 * sin(angle + pi + 0.5),
             lwd = 1.2)
    segments(body_x[3], body_y[3], 
             body_x[3] + size * 0.6 * cos(angle + pi - 0.5),
             body_y[3] + size * 0.6 * sin(angle + pi - 0.5),
             lwd = 1.2)
    
    # Custom label positioning for each snail
    label_offset <- 0.4  # Increased offset for better visibility
    
    if (label == "A") {
      # A - higher up
      label_angle <- atan2(y, x) + pi/2  # 90 degrees upward
      label_x <- x + label_offset * cos(label_angle)
      label_y <- y + label_offset * sin(label_angle) + 0.15  # Increased upward shift
    } else if (label == "B") {
      # B - moved left and up
      label_angle <- atan2(y, x)  # Original angle
      label_x <- x + label_offset * cos(label_angle) + 0.1  # Reduced right shift (moved left)
      label_y <- y + 0.1  # Moved up
    } else if (label == "E") {
      # E - bottom right of the top snail
      label_angle <- atan2(y, x)  # Original angle
      label_x <- x + label_offset * cos(label_angle) + 0.2  # Right shift
      label_y <- y + label_offset * sin(label_angle) - 0.4  # Downward shift
    } else if (label == "C") {
      # C - moved further up
      label_angle <- atan2(y, x) - pi/2  # 90 degrees downward
      label_x <- x + label_offset * cos(label_angle)
      label_y <- y + label_offset * sin(label_angle) + 0.05  # Positive shift (moved up)
    } else if (label == "D") {
      # D - immediately below its snail
      label_angle <- atan2(y, x) - pi/2  # 90 degrees downward
      label_x <- x + label_offset * cos(label_angle)
      label_y <- y + label_offset * sin(label_angle) - 0.1  # Downward shift
    } else {
      # Default positioning
      label_angle <- atan2(y, x)
      label_x <- x + label_offset * cos(label_angle)
      label_y <- y + label_offset * sin(label_angle)
    }
    
    text(label_x, label_y, label, font = 2, cex = 3.0, col = "black")  # Doubled font size
  }
  
  # Calculate snail positions with new labeling
  angles <- seq(300, 300 + 288, length.out = 5) * pi / 180
  radii <- c(1.6, 1.3, 1.2, 1.3, 1.6)
  snail_x <- radii * cos(angles)
  snail_y <- radii * sin(angles)
  
  # Draw and label snails with NEW LABELS according to your specifications:
  # Old E becomes A, Old C becomes E, Old B becomes C, Old A becomes B
  # Changed E to bright magenta
  snail_colors <- c("gold", "lightgreen", "magenta", "plum", "coral")  # E is now magenta
  new_labels <- c("B", "C", "E", "D", "A")  # Mapping: position 1->B, 2->C, 3->E, 4->D, 5->A
  
  for(i in 1:5) {
    draw_snail(snail_x[i], snail_y[i], angles[i], 0.25, snail_colors[i], new_labels[i])
  }
  
  # Add ground
  rect(-1.8, -1.5, 1.8, -1.7, col = "darkgreen", border = NA)
  
  # Add grass details
  grass_x <- runif(300, -1.8, 1.8)
  grass_y <- runif(300, -1.7, -1.5)
  segments(grass_x, grass_y, grass_x, grass_y + runif(300, 0.05, 0.15), 
           col = "darkgreen", lwd = sample(c(0.5, 1), 300, replace = TRUE))
}

# Define pairwise interactions with NEW LABELS
get_interaction_text <- function(snail1, snail2) {
  pairs <- list(
    "B-C" = "Yes! You find that snails from these two populations do successfully interbreed.",
    "B-E" = "No! Snails from these two populations do not interbreed.",
    "B-D" = "No! You try, but snails from these populations do not interbreed",
    "B-A" = "No, these two populations do not interbreed",
    "C-E" = "No, snails from these two populations do not interbreed.",
    "C-D" = "No, you tried, but you found that snails from these two populations do not interbreed.",
    "C-A" = "No, these two populations of snails do not interbreed.",
    "E-D" = "Yes! You gave it a try, and you found that snails from these populations can interbreed successfully.",
    "E-A" = "No, it appears that snails from these two populations do not interbreed.",
    "D-A" = "Yes! You find that snails from these populations do interbreed."
  )
  
  key <- paste0(snail1, "-", snail2)
  reverse_key <- paste0(snail2, "-", snail1)
  
  if (key %in% names(pairs)) {
    return(pairs[[key]])
  } else if (reverse_key %in% names(pairs)) {
    return(pairs[[reverse_key]])
  } else {
    return("No documented interaction between these snails. Perhaps you've discovered something new!")
  }
}

# Define snail positions with NEW LABELS
angles <- seq(300, 300 + 288, length.out = 5) * pi / 180
radii <- c(1.6, 1.3, 1.2, 1.3, 1.6)
snail_coords <- data.frame(
  label = c("B", "C", "E", "D", "A"),  # New labels
  x = radii * cos(angles),
  y = radii * sin(angles)
)
